description: Reconnaissance of the 2026 San José del Palmar Earthquake in Armenia, Quindío: A 27-Year Comparison with the 1999 Event is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Francisco Galvis, Stanford University (stanford.edu). Armenia, the capital of Quindío in the Colombian coffee-growing region (“Eje Cafetero”), experienced two damaging earthquakes within twenty-seven years. The January 25, 1999 the shallow 1999 Córdoba/Quindío earthquake and the 2026 Mw 7.4 intraslab earthquake. Coverage: Colombia. DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: post-earthquake inspection, earthquake, seismic regulation, building performance, ground motion, nonstructural components. Published 2026-09-02. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
